title: Traefik Mesh Pod Info Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for the PodInfo object returned by the Traefik Mesh Controller API status endpoints.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Kubernetes pod name of the Traefik Mesh proxy node.

fields.name: IP
fields.description: IPv4 address of the mesh proxy pod.

fields.name: Ready
fields.description: Whether the proxy node pod is ready to handle mesh traffic.
